item.title: Augusta brothers arrested after meth and firearms discovered
item.description: Two teenage brothers were arrested Thursday morning after deputies found drugs and guns at a home on East Taylor Street, according to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. The post Augusta brothers arrested after meth and firearms discovered appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Kemp declares state of emergency for Georgia, readying state crews, National Guard for snow and ice
item.description: Gov. Brian Kemp announced a state of emergency for all Georgia counties Thursday ahead of a winter storm expected to dump snow and sleet onto the northern third of the state starting Saturday, potentially encasing the land in a layer of ice. The post Kemp declares state of emergency for Georgia, readying state crews, National Guard for snow and ice appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Split vote sets three more town halls on Augusta charter revise
item.description: Augusta's Charter Review Committee will hold three more town hall meetings prior to submitting its work to the legislature, in a move some members said would be time better spent elsewhere. item.title: Ice storm threat: Augusta urges residents to prepare as Winter Storm Fern bears down
item.description: Augusta officials warned Thursday that a potentially dangerous winter storm could hit the region this weekend, bringing a wintry mix that could turn roads into sheets of ice and knock out power.
